subject: Request: short customer quote & metrics for sales one-pager
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@oliveridge.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short customer quote & metrics for sales one-pager

Hi Emma —

Hope you’re doing well. We’re putting together a short one-pager and a handful of 1–2 line quotables from customers for an upcoming sales enablement deck and a booth at HLTH next month. Oliveridge has been one of the clearest examples of the latency and cost improvements customers see on Redwood, and we'd love to feature a concise impact snippet from you if you’re comfortable.

Quick asks (should take <10 minutes):
- A one-sentence quote we can use in marketing (example: "Redwood cut our inference cost by X% while keeping latency under Yms")
- One concrete metric we can call out (e.g., tokens/sec change, cost per 1k tokens, latency P95)
- Permission to use the Oliveridge logo and a one-line customer blurb (we’ll share the exact wording before publishing)

If easier, feel free to forward a line or two to me and I’ll format it. We can also sign any consent doc you need — I’ve cc’d Lauren from marketing to coordinate assets and Sean from your AM team for the deal context.

Thanks again for being so collaborative — this would be a great short piece highlighting what we achieved together. Can we get this by EOD Monday (May 24)?

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical

Attachment(s) referenced: Oliveridge Q1-Q2 metrics (will follow if helpful)

From: Emma Clarke <emma@oliveridge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@oliveridge.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short customer quote & metrics for sales one-pager

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the note and congrats on the HLTH prep. Happy to help. Quick answers below and I attached the two-slide metrics export from Q1–Q2.

Quote for marketing (feel free to edit for tone):
"With Redwood, we reduced end-to-end inference cost by ~42% and saw P95 latency drop from 380ms to 120ms — that improvement unlocked real-time features for our clinicians."

Callout metric: "42% reduction in inference cost (Q1 vs Q2), P95 latency improved 380ms → 120ms"

Permission: You have permission to use Oliveridge’s logo and the short blurb: "Oliveridge integrated Redwood to run clinical NLP inference at scale while cutting cost and improving latency." Kyle has signed off. I attached a signed logo consent PDF (consent_logo_use_signed.pdf).

If you want a 1–2 sentence executive quote instead of the line above, let me know — I can route to our CPO.

Best,
Emma Clarke
Head of Data Products, Oliveridge
emma@oliveridge.com | +1 617-222-4001

Attachment(s): oliveridge_metrics_Q1-Q2.xlsx, consent_logo_use_signed.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@oliveridge.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short customer quote & metrics for sales one-pager

Emma —

This is fantastic, thank you. I’m attaching the draft one-pager language here (link in HubSpot/Drive) and Lauren will drop final assets into our shared drive. Lauren — would you pull the metric callout into the hero line and add the quote as a pull-quote? Sean — I’ll loop you in on approval for the final customer-facing deck.

Emma, quick follow-up: would Oliveridge be open to a 15–20 minute recorded customer video (phone screen share + 2 questions) about the business impact? It would be optional but high-impact for sales enablement. If yes, who should we coordinate with — the CPO or Kyle?

We’ll only publish after final signoff from you on the copy. Target to have assets ready by Wednesday May 26 for internal enablement.

Thanks again — really appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Emma Clarke <emma@oliveridge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short customer quote & metrics for sales one-pager

Hi all —

We’re happy to do the short recorded piece. Kyle can coordinate scheduling — he’s cc’d on the original thread but I’ve included him here. He suggested a few slots this week: Wed 2pm ET or Thu 11am ET. Either works for us.

Also, our CPO (Alyssa Perez) offered this alternate executive quote if you prefer an executive voice: "Redwood helped us move from experimental to clinical scale — the performance gains materially expanded our product roadmap."

We reviewed Lauren’s first draft and signed off on the wording with a tiny edit to the blurb (attached as a one-line suggestion). Lauren, I left the edit inline in the Drive doc.

Looking forward — happy to finalize after the short recording.

Thanks,
Emma
